original.target_description: Study 4: no-induction control condition; information selection consistent versus inconsistent with the preliminary personnel decision, comparing 2 versus 10 available pieces of information; chi-square interaction between Information Quantity and Information Selection.

n.sample_role: Participants in the no-induction control condition included in the target 2 × 2 chi-square analysis; 26 in each information-quantity group.
n.exclusions: Target analysis restricted to the no-induction condition; quality-focus and direction-focus groups are separate experimental conditions. Participant exclusions are not reported for this test.
n.location: Published article p. 241 (PDF p. 11), Study 4, Results and Discussion, first paragraph, no-induction condition

notes: Fresh original-only validation from supplied published article; title and authors match the supplied reference. The target is the basic information-quantity effect within the no-induction condition on PDF p. 11, rather than either induced-focus condition or the three-way log-linear analysis. Whole-study recruitment is 155 participants and is not used as target analytic n. Mathematical font glyphs in quotations are normalized to standard Unicode characters; numbers and printed precision are preserved. Replication and reported_success are unassigned placeholders.
